title: AI & translation
privacy: Connections and keys stay on this device and are never synced to Backspace. Keys are encrypted by the operating system and used only for direct requests to the configured provider. Your instance’s web client must be trusted. Successful translations are cached locally with OS encryption, up to 1,000 entries / 16 MiB per account. No upload or sync. Logout clears memory but keeps the encrypted local cache for reuse.
baseUrlHelp: Enter the API root including its version, not a full endpoint: OpenAI /v1, Anthropic /v1, Gemini /v1beta. HTTPS is required except HTTP on localhost / 127.0.0.1 / [::1]. URLs cannot contain credentials, query parameters or fragments.
keyStored: Stored securely; leave blank to keep
keyOptional: Optional for services that do not require authentication
noKey: Use without a key (remove any stored key)
recipientChanged: The URL or protocol changed. Enter a new key, or explicitly select “Use without a key”. The old key will not be forwarded.
anonymousWarning: Unofficial public web endpoints: availability, quotas and terms may change. Eligible text is sent to Google / Microsoft using this client’s translation backend. No automatic fallback or rate-limit bypass.
consent: I agree to send eligible message text to my selected provider for translation. AI API usage may incur charges. Other providers’ data retention policies apply.
automatic: Automatically translate visible foreign-language text messages
automaticHelp: Only user-authored natural-language text is eligible. Language detection runs locally. Same-language, uncertain, code-only, link-only and emoji-only messages are not sent. No background history scan. Translated messages refresh when their edited body becomes visible; rapid consecutive edits submit only the settled text.
displayHelp: On: original with translation below (WeChat style). Off: translated text replaces the visible message body (Telegram style). The original message is never edited or shared as a translation.
automaticPaused: Background translation and edit refresh are paused after an error.

skipped.uncertain-language: Language could not be identified confidently; nothing was sent.

errors.invalid-input: Invalid input. Check endpoint, credentials and text length (AI: 6,000; experimental: 3,000 characters).
errors.untrusted-sender: Your translation session is unavailable or belongs to another account. Sign in to your home instance.
errors.secure-storage: Secure OS storage is unavailable. No plaintext key storage will be used.
errors.storage: Encrypted AI settings could not be read or saved. Check storage and the encryption key.
errors.consent-required: Enable third-party text processing in AI & translation settings first.
errors.stale-settings: Settings changed; the outdated result was discarded.
errors.busy: A translation is already in progress.
errors.network: Translation request failed at the network layer; check connectivity and endpoint.
errors.invalid-response: The provider returned invalid data or an incomplete translation.
errors.protected-content: The provider changed protected code, links or chat tokens. Translation rejected.
errors.anonymous-unavailable: The experimental web endpoint is unavailable or its response format changed.
errors.cache-storage: Cannot read or save the encrypted translation cache; no silent repeat request was made.
errors.server-not-configured: Server translation is unavailable. Ask the administrator to deploy a compatible version and check startup logs and data-volume permissions. New installations generate their encryption key automatically.
errors.unsafe-endpoint: Server translation only supports public HTTPS endpoints. Private addresses and unsafe DNS results are blocked.
errors.insecure-transport: Use HTTPS to protect API keys and message text in transit (HTTP is permitted only on localhost).

serverPrivacy: Web translation sends your connection settings, API key and eligible message text to your Backspace home server. Settings and successful translations are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM using an independent key generated automatically on first startup or supplied by the administrator. The server decrypts credentials in memory to call your provider; administrators can access them. This is not end-to-end encryption. Settings are private to your account, not federated or shared with other users. Cache: 1,000 entries / 16 MiB per account. Desktop-local settings are separate and never uploaded automatically.
serverBaseUrlHelp: Enter the API root including its version, not a full endpoint (for example /v1). Server requests require HTTPS and a public internet address. Localhost, private networks, metadata addresses and redirects are blocked. No credentials, query parameters or fragments in the base URL.
serverConsent: I trust this Backspace server to process my API key and eligible message text and send text to my selected provider. Server administrators can access this data. AI usage may incur charges; provider retention policies apply.
serverAutomaticHelp: Only visible user-authored natural-language text is eligible. The server detects language before contacting the provider. Same-language, uncertain, code-only, link-only and emoji-only messages are not sent to the provider. No history scan. Translations refresh after body edits and cached results are reused.
modelHelp: Fetch models from this endpoint, or enter a model ID manually. A listed model may still require separate access.
noModels: No generative models were returned. Enter a model ID manually if your provider supports it.
diagnosticHelp: These buttons contact the current endpoint using the entered or securely stored key, without saving. Testing sends only a fixed sample and may incur a small API charge; no translation cache is used.
localSummary: Private AI connections on this device, with optional message translation.
serverSummary: Private AI connections on your home server, with optional message translation.
noConnections: No AI connections yet. Add a protocol, API endpoint and key to get started.
